summary: HDFC Bank filed a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K) disclosing that Mr. Sanjay D'Souza superannuated from the Bank effective close of business on October 31, 2026, ceasing to be Group Head of Business Banking and the Emerging Micro Enterprises Group and a Senior Management Personnel. The notice, signed by Company Secretary Ajay Agarwal, is a routine retirement announcement after nearly 27 years of service, credits him as a key architect of the SME franchise, and contains no transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics. Risk-arb angle: none; not a special situation.
